about_the_game:
From Phoenix Limit Studios (the creators of The Multiverse Trilogy, Alternate Universe and more) comes Unreal Zombies, a fast-paced FPS zombies horror game that brings you into a post-apocalyptic world. This world was once your home, your planet, your life. You’ve been sent to mysterious ruins by a failed science test, and your only goal is to find your way out. As you move forward, you’re going to face weird, creepy, and strong creatures. You play as Rust. A gentleman who, although looks beaten up, can still find joy of himself as he moves forward. From place to place, you find clues as to who destroyed your home, and is up to you to save humanity.

Unreal Zombies is also an old version of The Unreal Story that was released back in 2020, but was later taken down in late 2021 due to how unfinished it was. This new version of the game is served as a full complete linear experience that was once never achieved when making this game, and also a love letter to what was once a first ever project.

Features:

  • Single-player

  • 1 weapon with few abilities that enhances the gameplay

  • 12 maps

  • Encore mode

  • Powered by Unreal Engine 5
